profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer @ LinkedIn | Optimization PhD
profile.summary:
With over six years of experience as a software engineer, I am passionate about developing innovative and scalable solutions for complex and real-life problems. Currently, I am part of the jobs marketplace core team at LinkedIn Talent Solutions, where I work on new features related to the billing and job posting experience for the Enterprise Jobs Platform.

My background in optimization, computer science, and computer engineering has equipped me with the skills and knowledge to design and implement efficient algorithms and techniques for various applications. I have published papers on multidimensional assignment problem. I am also proficient in C++, Java, among other languages, tools and technologies. My goal is to contribute to the improvement of tools and services that enhance the professional growth and opportunities of millions of users.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Develop and evolve large-scale distributed systems powering LinkedIn’s job search and matching experiences for millions of members.
• Lead cross-functional technical initiatives spanning multiple systems and engineering teams, driving architecture, migrations, rollout strategy, and production readiness.
• Drive platform-wide modernization efforts, including Channel Management and Channel Entitlements (CEMS), coordinating dependencies and technical decisions across Careers, Talent Marketplace, Pacing, Billing, and other partner teams.
• Influence technical direction beyond my immediate team through design reviews, architectural guidance, reliability improvements, and scalable engineering patterns adopted across systems.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
* Development of monetization and marketplace systems powering LinkedIn Jobs, spanning Pay-for-Performance (P4P) jobs, budget recommendations, applicant forecasting, bidding and pacing, job promotion, and billing.
* Drove Partner P4P initiatives including budget recommendations and smart budget allocation, dynamically determining budgets across partner campaigns to improve budget utilization and customer value.
* Improved job pacing and bidding systems to optimize marketplace bidding and increase revenue, while building automated monitoring and escalation mechanisms for customer-impacting charging issues.
* Reduced critical-path latency of budget recommendation services by more than 50%, improving performance and scalability of revenue-critical Jobs workflows.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer II
positions.description:
Forecasting Service. Improvements on accuracy and latency for the forecasting service used at the Commerce Platform (Cost Explorer) of AWS. 
Accuracy Service. Development of a lambda function for accuracy metrics publishing and testing of forecasting models.
positions.insights: Skills: Software Development · Forecasting · Communication · Mockito · Programming Languages · Passionate about Work · Java · Guice · Unit Testing · Java Virtual Machine (JVM) · Debugging · Software Systems · Agile Methodologies

positions.title: Systems Analyst
positions.description: Improvement of the cash remittance module of the system called Cash flow system (Sistema de Flujos de Caja - Sifca) to incorporate the handled of labels for recording of packages of bank notes and having a better control of the stocks of cash at each step of the distribution process.

positions.title: Researcher in Statistics/Software Developer
positions.description:
•	Reports generation. Reduction time in generation of statistical reports in more than 95%. Development in R, Sybase and Oracle.
•	Software creation. Development of desktop applications for a better management of report generation. Development in Java and R.
*      Data consistency. Creation of systems that validates data consistency among different databases. This allowed to increase the data quality through the detection and correction of inconsistencies and errors between the information corresponding to the same transactions but from different databases. Development in R, Sybase and Oracle.
*       Forecasts for the demand of banknotes and coinage. Design and implementation of some modules of a forecasts system, as well as the speed up of other modules for a better performance and faster data management, as well as a faster obtaining of the forecasts. Development in R.

positions.title: Machine Learning Intern
positions.description:
•	Job description classifier. Development of a classifier that determines when a job position is more attractive for job seekers based on the words used in the job description as well as in its structure. This classifier has an effectiveness of 80%. Development in Python using scikit learn library. 
•	Job matching score. Development of a ranking program that determines how a job seeker matches a job based on the skills of job seekers (provided in their resumes) and in the required skills at job descriptions. This system allows to provide the most qualified job seekers for a job. Development in Python.
positions.insights: Skills: Software Development · Communication · Heuristic Analysis · Programming Languages · Machine Learning · Algorithm Development

positions.title: Professor
positions.locationName: Cuajimalpa de Morelos, Mexico City, Mexico
positions.description: •	Courses taught. Programming (Winter-2014, Winter-2015), Data Structures (Fall-2014), Security (Spring-2013, Fall-2014), User Interfaces (Fall-2013, Spring-2014), Operating Systems (Fall-2013), Developing and commerce of software products (Spring-2013), Software Engineering (Winter-2013), Databases (Fall-2012) and Data Mining (Level Intro Fall 2012, Winter-2014). http://computacion.cs.cinvestav.mx/~sperez/cursos/

positions.title: Contractor as assistant of researcher
positions.description:
•	Project portfolio optimization. Development of a web application (.Net) for helping managers to get best projects based on strategical objectives. This optimization is based on a mathematical model. Development in C# and .net.
•	Assignment problem. Implementation of several algorithms for large scale assignment problems. Development in C++.
positions.insights: Skills: Software Development · C++ · Programming Languages · Algorithm Development · Software Systems
